'''Takodana's sun''' was a [[star]] in the [[Tashtor sector]], located in the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]. It was [[orbit]]ed by the [[planet]] [[Takodana]], where the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]] operated her [[Takodana Castle|castle]].<ref name="SWTVE" />
